description:
One day, after the accident at the ski resort, Miss Nam-Yeon Jon, who trains very hard at Muju Taekwondo Academy, wakes up in a different body. She is trapped by Je-Il Sho's body, who works at the ski resort. Now, they both need to find a way to come back. Read now to find out if that will be possible!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/56049308), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5682456)

**Official Translations:**  
English, French, German, Spanish, B.Portuguese, Italian
